endpoint_taxonomy.competing_risk_crash_or_failure: attempt ended in a distinct failure risk and is not pooled with walltime censoring
endpoint_taxonomy.cost_screened: method was deliberately not attempted under the accepted cost screen
endpoint_taxonomy.ladder_exhaustion: all accepted ladder rungs were exhausted without solution
endpoint_taxonomy.solution: accepted endpoint satisfied the stored task threshold

estimate_labels.descriptive: descriptive estimate; not a population ratio unless explicitly marked design-based
estimate_labels.external_validation: external-validation estimate; failed gates are findings, not missing results
estimate_labels.frozen_posterior: frozen posterior estimate; do not refit at export
estimate_labels.prediction: estimated solvability; not a validated predictor

base.definition: Observed and estimated solver-family records carried forward from bundle v2.

difficulty.definition: Frozen task posterior estimates and accepted corroboration metadata.

group_inference.definition: Grouped descriptive inference with multiplicity-adjusted honest-negative results.

instance_space.definition: Frozen coordinates and descriptive footprint geometry; failed adequacy gates remain attached.

pyscf.definition: Observed electronic-structure labels, explicit missingness classes, and descriptive frontiers.

resource_profiles.definition: Observed endpoint classes plus descriptive censored profiles and conditional quantiles.

metric_distinction.interpretation: The binding selection used 191 columns. The accepted solver-family analysis and placement space use 193 columns; the two added narrow-applicability columns do not retroactively change the binding selection.
